# EtTh q^(1/2) recipe (from special 2-torsion)

## Source

* EtTh Theorem 1.10(iii): {±1}-structure on the (K^x)^-torsor at the cusp.
* EtTh Remark 1.10.1: special 2-torsion point = 2-torsion whose special-fiber
  image lies in the same irreducible component as the origin; reduces
  12 = 2*(3!) to 2.
* EtTh Corollary 2.8(ii): with an l-th root of unity and rational cusps, the
  {±1}-structure determines a mu_{2l}-structure on the cusp (K^x)^-torsor.
* notesoniut line 869: the monoid generated by O_L^x and nonnegative powers of
  Theta has a canonical splitting, up to mu_{2l}, via evaluation at a
  2-torsion point.
* Tan slides lines 800-806: mu_- is the unique 2-torsion whose closure
  intersects component 0; evaluation points are mu_-translations of cusps;
  Theta_v at label j lies in the mu_{2l}-orbit of q_v^{j^2}.

## Recipe

Normalize Theta_v at the special 2-torsion evaluation section:

  Theta_v = q[2u]v[1u] = q[1u]v[1u]^(1/2l)   up to mu_{2l}.

Then

  q^(1/2) = Theta_v^l,

and its Kummer class is the evaluation/Kummer class of Theta_v^l.
The monoid O_L^x * Theta^N splits canonically up to mu_{2l}.

## Number of underlines

  q[1u]v[1u] = q-parameter (ONE underline)
  q[2u]v[1u] = q[1u]^(1/2l) (TWO underlines)
  Theta_v = q[2u]v[1u] up to mu_{2l}
  q^(1/2) = Theta_v^l
